alt: Table of the six post-expansion years and their average: the event-study coefficient, the drift a violation could accumulate per unit of M-bar, and the breakdown value of M-bar, which falls from about 6.7 in 2014 to about 2.0 in 2019.

columns.label: Drift allowed per unit of M̄ (pts)

note: Evaluated at the point estimates; sampling uncertainty would lower every breakdown value.
source: IPUMS USA, ACS 1-year samples 2011–2019; PERWT-weighted event study from Chapter 6
title: Later years tolerate less drift per year, because a violation has had longer to accumulate
